# `grow-hashicorp-vault` (`grow_hashicorp_vault`) — agent quickstart (Python)

Ships inside the wheel (`python -c "import grow_hashicorp_vault, pathlib; print(pathlib.Path(grow_hashicorp_vault.__file__).with_name('AGENTS.md').read_text())"`).
Docs: https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/hashicorp-vault/ · Service: HashiCorp Vault · Categories: secrets.

```sh
pip install grow-hashicorp-vault
# PyPI may not carry it yet: pip install "grow-hashicorp-vault @ git+https://github.com/grow-codes-packages/hashicorp-vault@python-vX.Y.Z#subdirectory=python"
```

## Client

```python
from grow_hashicorp_vault import VaultClient

# GROW_HASHICORP_VAULT_* > vendor env > defaults (AsyncVaultClient has the same API)
client = VaultClient.from_env()
client.close()
```

Errors: `VaultError` subclasses (`ConfigError`, `AuthenticationError`, `NotFoundError`, …) with `code`,
`retryable`, `http_status`. Credentials are `Secret`; never log `reveal()` results.

## Secrets: load the service configuration (one call)

```python
from grow_hashicorp_vault import load_config

# before settings are read; writes os.environ
load_config(required=["DATABASE_URL"])
```

- `load_config(required: list[str] | None = None, into_env: bool = True, *, path=None, override=True,
  env=None, connect=None) -> dict[str, str]`
- Reads the platform bootstrap `GROW_SECRETS_PROVIDER` (must be `hashicorp-vault`), `GROW_SECRETS_ADDR`,
  `GROW_SECRETS_KV_MOUNT`, `GROW_SECRETS_PATH`, `GROW_SECRETS_AUTH=approle` + `GROW_SECRETS_ROLE_ID`/`_SECRET_ID`
  (AppRole login), then every key under `GROW_SECRETS_PATH`. Missing required keys → `NotFoundError`.
- No bootstrap (local dev) or `GROW_SECRETS_LOADED=1` (grow-secrets-exec) → nothing is read; `required` is
  checked against `os.environ`.
- Also: `load_config_from(provider, ...)`, `read_secrets_bootstrap(env)`, `secrets_preloaded(env)`.
